verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a headless daemon (llmster), a REST API, and an interactive agent (Bionic). None of it documents user-configurable automations, schedules, or triggers that run agent tasks autonomously in the background. The headless server and API are developer building blocks for inference, not an automation feature. Bionic is described only as an interactive agent you work with directly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
